findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: apm_quote, apm_categories, apm_register, apm_feedback · Private data: apm_register, answer_daily_question · Public sink: apm_quote, apm_preview, apm_categories, apm_register, apm_feedback, leave_intel · Destructive: apm_quote, apm_preview, apm_categories, apm_register, apm_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: apm_quote, apm_categories, apm_register, apm_feedback · Private data: apm_register, answer_daily_question · Public sink: apm_quote, apm_preview, apm_categories, apm_register, apm_feedback, leave_intel · Destructive: apm_quote, apm_preview, apm_categories, apm_register, apm_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
